summary: Notes: unsaved drafts survive leaving the page (renderer memory only), restored-draft / changed-elsewhere / deleted-elsewhere notices, Revert/Clear draft, inline save-failure notice, clearer delete confirmation (size, tags, referencing capsules, backup caveat), paged note list (100 at a time) with cheap snippets and a once-per-change search index, keyboard navigation of the list, stuck tag filter fix and clear-filters actions. Memory search: every result shows a truthful source line, the note-tag filter suggests tags that exist, and filters can be cleared in one click.
unchangedContracts: No change to the store schema, JarvisAPI bridge, search service, package.json, shared contracts or any other worker path. Notes still saves through api.saveNote/api.deleteNote; search still uses searchState. No new dependencies.

checks.result: 1095 tests, 1095 pass, 0 fail (includes the existing MemorySearch tests in autopilot-productivity)

behaviours: Drafts: module-level in-memory cache (max 20, newest wins) keyed by note id or 'new'; restored on return to Notes unless a deep link names another note; cleared by save, Revert/Clear draft, discard and delete. Never written to disk or sent anywhere; lost when the app closes (stated in the UI).

Stale protection: draft remembers the saved version's updatedAt; if the stored note changed meanwhile a warning says Save replaces it. A note deleted elsewhere keeps its text and Save stores it as a new note.
Save: failure leaves the text in place with an inline alert; a successful save re-reads the stored note (keeps text typed while the save was in flight). Ctrl+S unchanged.
Delete: dialog (Cancel focused) states size/tags, that it cannot be undone and that backups may keep an older copy, and names capsules that still reference the note.

List: 100 notes per page with 'Show N more (M not shown)'; snippet reads only the first 400 characters; lower-cased haystacks built once per notes change; search uses useDeferredValue; status line reports 'X of Y notes match' and best-50 truncation.
Keyboard: ArrowDown from search enters the list; Up/Down/Home/End move between notes, Escape returns to search; Escape clears the search box.
Filters: an active tag filter whose tag disappeared is cleared automatically; a hidden (beyond top 16) active tag shows a removable chip; no-match state has 'Clear search and tag filter'.

Memory search: describeSource() (exported) adds a source line built only from stored records (note tags/updated/capsule that references it, task state/due, checkpoint's capsule, chat source, calendar/other-module source); unknown records add nothing. Tag filter input gets a datalist of existing tags; 'Clear filters' appears when any filter is active.
interfaceProposals: Notes.tsx now also exports NOTE_PAGE, noteDrafts, noteSnippet, sameDraft; MemorySearch.tsx exports describeSource(result, state, productivity?, external?). The captain may reuse describeSource for Home/Search source labels.
If the captain wants drafts to survive an app restart, that would need an explicit persisted-drafts store and consent copy; deliberately not done here.
limitations: No DOM library is available, so tests render static markup and call exported pure helpers; the interactive paths (typing, Save, Delete click, list keyboard movement, Show more, Revert) are type-checked but not exercised by an automated test.
Delete-confirmation wording is pinned by a source-level test because ConfirmDialog renders nothing while closed.
Edits are not merged: a changed-elsewhere warning is shown, and Save overwrites the stored version only when the user presses it.
Unsaved drafts are not kept across an app restart or window reload.
Search ranking, citations and the search service were not modified; the 50-result search cap still bounds ranked note lists.
